selected.title: Swift provides cross-border gateway to Bizum, PayID and Pix users
selected.summary: Swift has launched an initiative to bring the pay-by-alias experience of domestic national payment systems, Bizum, PayID and Pix, to cross-border transactions, enabling consumers to send money internationally using a mobile number or email address, rather than account details.
selected.why: Swift launching cross-border pay-by-alias connecting domestic payment networks like Pix and PayID is a major infrastructure expansion.

reason: Swift's pay-by-alias cross-border expansion raises arguable questions about whether standardising on aliases reduces financial transparency and anti-money laundering effectiveness versus improving consumer experience.
angle: Cross-border pay-by-alias convenience may undermine beneficial financial transparency that current account-based systems provide for detecting illicit flows.
